description.value: Earls Robson is a location of the well-known Canadian casual-dining chain, situated on Vancouver's busy Robson Street shopping corridor. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating with American-influenced cuisine and caters to vegan and vegetarian diners. Its central position in the West End makes it a convenient urban stop on a popular cycling and pedestrian thoroughfare.
